summary: U19 youth squads are discovered by parent short → lp32 name → colocated subunit job-list. The live list sits BEFORE the name label (list → long/short names); after-name lists are often decoys/neighbours. This is NOT the II affiliate clubId/team-body join.

discovery.input: managed parent short name only (e.g. Schalke 04)
steps: Prefer exact mid-file (~40–120MB) catalog row: u32le length prefix + UTF-8 f'{parentShort} U19'
From the start of the name, within −400 bytes, take the last subunit header motif: ff×4 | 00 | ff×4 | count:u16∈[3,50] | jobs:u32×n (list precedes name)
Require a majority of jobs in 50000..2000000
Fallback only: list within +150 bytes after the name (often neighbour/decoy)
If exact miss: fuzzy-match other lp32 names ending ' U19' in the same band (exact core, endswith, token cover, or stem≥6 chars / ≥70% of shorter)
Prefer higher match score, then shorter label (short form over long form)
discovery.subunitHeader: ff×4 | u32 | u32 | ff×4 | 00 | ff×4 | count:u16 | jobs:u32×n  (parser anchors on trailing ff×4|00|ff×4 before count)
discovery.contrastWithII: II uses early catalog + clubId@+23 + pre-name teamId/dup → mid-file team body. U19 names sit beside their live list; do not require II after-name marker or team-body join.

falsePositives.iiClubIdRecipe: Early catalog f'{S} U19' with after_name+23 does not appear — U19 is mid-file name-colocated only
falsePositives.afterNameDecoy: After-name list on Schalke short row was a wrong 27-man squad (Alparslan/Fayet/…). Live squad (Kraft/Solo/Eschweiler/Breite) is the BEFORE-name list (n=25, Δ≈−165). Prior lock used after-name and was incorrect.
falsePositives.longVsShortPair: Rows often store long then short labels (FC Schalke 04 U19 → Schalke 04 U19) sharing one preceding list; exact short match or shorter fuzzy label is preferred

Schalke 04.note: verification outputs only — offsets move per save; do not hardcode as discovery inputs
